result:
I made three changes for the switched-off webhook problems, and the existing server and contract tests pass (88 tests). I didn't add tests for the new behaviour, so the switch-off, delivery-run and allowance cases aren't exercised.

1. **Switching off now sticks.** `updateEndpoint` in `src/server/repositories/webhook-repository.ts` only wrote `enabled` when it was `true`, so `false` was silently dropped. It now writes the value whenever one is given, so switching off and back on both work. The queueing code already skips switched-off endpoints, so no new deliveries are queued once the flag saves.
2. **Delivery run.** In `src/server/jobs/webhook-delivery-job.ts`, a queued delivery whose endpoint is switched off is now marked failed ("endpoint is switched off") and counted as failed. A missing endpoint was already marked failed. Deliveries for endpoints that are still on go out and are counted as before.
3. **Endpoint allowance.** `createWebhook` in `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts` now uses `countEndpoints`, which counts every endpoint including switched-off ones. Switching one off no longer makes room for another.
